from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CitationRelation(BaseModel):
    """One citation relationship: this paper cites another paper from the collection."""
    citing_paper: str | None = Field(description="Title of the paper that contains the citation")
    cited_paper: str | None = Field(description="Title of the paper being cited (from the provided collection)")
    citation_location: str | None = Field(description="Where in the paper the citation appears (e.g., reference number, footnote marker)")

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its title and which other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title as written in the document")
    cites_other_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list; empty list if none")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate all papers and their citation relationships from the document collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
